editorial.headline: The Retail Trade Behind Non-Motorised Land Transport
editorial.standfirst: Nationally open to full foreign ownership, this retail activity faces a clear Bali reality: PMA registration is blocked under the island-wide moratorium.
editorial.body:
A foreign investor cannot register this retail activity through PMA in Bali today. That is the decisive local fact, even though the national position is fully open to foreign ownership. The activity therefore carries a sharp distinction between a nationally available investment classification and its present treatment in Bali, where the applicable risk-based moratorium closes the PMA registration route.

The activity is retail trade in non-motorised land transport equipment and the parts and accessories that belong with it. Its scope reaches from bicycles designed for people with disabilities to becak, carts, wagons, horse-drawn carriages and push carts, as well as their components and related equipment. This is a defined retail field: the commercial focus is the sale of non-motorised means of land transport and the practical items that keep them complete and usable.

Registration is open across the full business-scale range: micro, small, medium and large enterprises. At the national level, the PMA status is open, with a foreign-ownership ceiling of 100%. The national source cited for that position is Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021. For a founder considering the activity beyond Bali, that is the relevant national reading: foreign participation is not capped below full ownership.

Bali’s result is different because the large-scale OSS risk classification is Low or Medium-Low across every scope of this activity. Bali blocks all Low and Medium-Low risk KBLI activities for PMA on an island-wide, permanent basis. The restriction is recorded as a blocked-by-risk-class status and is tied to the Bali moratorium effective from 13 May 2026. The practical conclusion is straightforward: national openness does not create a PMA registration path for this activity in Bali while that moratorium applies.
